execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."Caja" (
  "descripcion" text,
  "idCaja" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombreCaja" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idCaja")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Combustible" (
  "idCombustible" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombreCombustible" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idCombustible")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Condicion" (
  "idCondicion" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombreCondicion" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idCondicion")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Dimensiones" (
  "alto" float8 NOT NULL,
  "ancho" float8 NOT NULL,
  "idDimensiones" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "largo" float8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idDimensiones")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Estado" (
  "idEstado" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idEstado")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."HistorialPublicacion" (
  "fechaHoraFinalizacion" timestamptz,
  "fechaHoraInicio" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "idEstado" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idPublicacion" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idPublicacion", "fechaHoraInicio")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Marca" (
  "idMarca" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombreMarca" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idMarca")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MetricasPublicacion" (
  "fechaHora" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "idMetrica" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "idPublicacion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idTipoEvento" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idMetrica")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Modelo" (
  "idMarca" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idModelo" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombreModelo" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idModelo")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Motor" (
  "descripcion" text,
  "idMotor" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "idTipoMotor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "potencia" float8,
  "torque" float8,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idMotor")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Multimedia" (
  "idArchivo" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "idPublicacion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "urlArchMultimedia" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idArchivo")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Publicacion" (
  "descripcion" text NOT NULL,
  "idPublicacion" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "idUsuario" int4 NOT NULL,
  "precio" float8 NOT NULL,
  "titulo" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idPublicacion")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Segmento" (
  "idSegmento" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombreSegmento" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idSegmento")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TipoCarroceria" (
  "idTipoCarroceria" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombreTipoCarroceria" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idTipoCarroceria")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TipoDireccion" (
  "descripcion" text,
  "idTipoDireccion" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idTipoDireccion")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TipoEvento" (
  "idTipoEvento" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idTipoEvento")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TipoMotor" (
  "idTipoMotor" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombreTipo" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idTipoMotor")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TipoTapizado" (
  "descripcion" text,
  "idTipoTapizado" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombreTipoTapizado" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idTipoTapizado")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Traccion" (
  "idTraccion" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombreTraccion" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idTraccion")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Usuario" (
  "contraseña" text NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "idUsuario" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idUsuario")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Vehiculo" (
  "anio" int4 NOT NULL,
  "cantidadAirbags" int4 NOT NULL,
  "cantidadAsientos" int4 NOT NULL,
  "cantidadPuertas" int4 NOT NULL,
  "capacidadBaul" float8,
  "capacidadRemolque" float8,
  "capacidadTanque" float8,
  "codigoVehiculo" text NOT NULL,
  "color" text NOT NULL,
  "idCaja" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idCombustible" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idCondicion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idDimensiones" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idModelo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idMotor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idPublicacion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idSegmento" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idTipoCarroceria" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idTipoDireccion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idTipoTapizado" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idTraccion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "kilometros" int4 NOT NULL,
  "patente" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("patente")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Version" (
  "descripcion" text,
  "idModelo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "idVersion" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombreVersion" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("idVersion")
)
